config.measurement_protocol: Direct full-text segmentation with one shared contextual observation per case. Gold labels score only after prediction. Inference wall time surrounds that observation, excluding restoration/scoring/serialization; timings are descriptive, not a platform speed study. Training wall time and whole-worker RSS high-water include their stated scope. Checkpoint bytes measure JSON serialization, not compressed weights or resident model memory.
config.protocol: Bounded segmentation adaptation from one pinned EN/JA/ZH checkpoint. Native Ukrainian ParlaMint dates, including the provider's documented NSDC transcript, are pooled across upstream roles and split by actual source date; at least three dates are required, with min(5, source dates) hash-ordered folds. Polish/Czech PUD are translated auxiliaries and inherit the original EN/JA/ZH parallel-document role, not an independent-corpus test. Remove all candidate Slavic normalized duplicates crossing roles, including legacy-role exposure, before length filtering or caps; retain the original 279 old-language test cases unchanged. Compare pre-adaptation weights with Slavic-only warm continuation and the same Slavic exposure plus 96 old-language training cases per language. Rehearsal uses more examples and computation. Both training arms start from identical pretrained parameters; seeds control shuffle order, not independent pretrained initializations. Four fixed epochs, no development/test tuning or winner selection. Evaluate Slavic development/test and old-language retention; development scores never choose a checkpoint. Original text, apostrophes and combining marks remain unchanged. This measures surface boundary segmentation, not general Ukrainian fluency, semantic knowledge, calibrated correctness or production readiness. Earlier PUD checkpoint selection and retention cases were already inspected; Ukrainian test dates are few and bootstrap intervals are conditional on these documents, two shuffle seeds and the fixed starting checkpoint. Raw corpora and learned checkpoints remain local.

legacy_sources.tokenization: UD surface tokens (MWT rows replace components); whitespace gaps are separate exact spans
